audience: Shopify merchants who review wholesale and volume pricing rules with the Samita app

useCases.title: Review wholesale pricing rules and their customers
useCases.text: List the wholesale pricing rules with their status. Open one rule to read its customer rules, product rules and discount groups.

useCases.title: Check the volume pricing tiers of a rule
useCases.text: List the volume pricing rules with their type, quantity or amount. Open one rule to read its tier ranges and products.

useCases.title: Find draft rules across both rule sets
useCases.text: List the wholesale and volume rules of the store and check which ones are still drafts. Samita's endpoint docs allow about one request per five minutes per store, so reuse the result.
